title: One Photograph, Nine Images: Provenance-Aware Benchmarking of a Frozen VGG16 Classifier for Fresh and Rotten Fruit (code, splits and results)
description: Code, photo-level split assignments and results for a provenance-aware benchmark of a frozen ImageNet VGG16 classifier on the Kaggle 'Fruits Fresh and Rotten for Classification' collection (six classes). The collection's 13,599 unique images derive from 1,511 photographs stored in nine versions each; the repository provides photograph identifiers, image-level and photo-level splits, held-out predictions, duplicate audits, environment records and the Colab notebook. Dataset images are not redistributed.
